rule:
Frozen rule, fixed before any label is read: add an argmax-kept, sub-threshold scored pair (0.02 <= p < 0.80) when
at least two of the entity's already-kept records (p >= 0.80) each agree with it on name and address
(normalized trigram Jaccard >= 0.7 on both). Evaluated on India as the unseen country, same dump as sub18's France model.
